shared_fragments.text: **共享上下文与逻辑摘要续研完成 / Contextual logic continuation，2026-10-08。** [理论第7–10节](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-LOGIC.md)从原生取得／释放规律推出固定上下文的精确支承判据；指定工作负载的单支承摘要保留执行与整体步数预算，但不认证完整初始相容性或保持其他占用的准备。新37项 Lean 定理／220项闭包审计通过。[整合与反审](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CONTEXTUAL-LOGIC-INTEGRATION.md)。/ This closes the corresponding bounded next step below. Count-only readiness fails; selective abstraction retains explicit limits. Integration with existing resource logic is complete at this scope; novelty and richer interleaved targets remain separate.

**共享上下文续研已完成 / Contextual continuation completed，2026-10-08。** [当前第7–10节](unified-2026-10-05/GENERATED-LOGIC.md)推导固定上下文的精确适用条件，证明有限步判断的有范围摘要，并保留总量及完整相容性反例；新增37项 Lean 实查。/ This completes the frozen-context and selected-workload portion of the next bridge mentioned below. Preparation in the merged whole differs from preparation with other occupancy held fixed. The result is checked integration, with no established novelty over Iris/Leaf.

**生成逻辑第二轮 / Contextual logic continuation，2026-10-08。** [整合、对应、来源与作者反审](CONTEXTUAL-LOGIC-INTEGRATION.md)完成固定上下文支承判据、指定工作负载摘要及步数预算对应。新37项定理；继承183项，合计220审计。/ Preserved counterexamples distinguish a relevant-slot summary from total counts and full compatibility. Frozen-frame replay and merged-state preparation remain different contracts. The bounded first-round next step is closed; no independent-agent acceptance or frontier novelty is claimed.

**Contextual logic continuation, 8 October 2026.** [ContextualLeaseRules.lean](ContextualLeaseRules.lean) derives the exact frozen-frame footprint condition (16 new theorems); [ContextualLogicAbstraction.lean](ContextualLogicAbstraction.lean) checks selective execution/budget preservation and its failures (21 new). [Checker](check_contextual_logic.py): 220 audits, 124 empty; new 37 include 12 empty and 25 using only propext and/or Quot.sound. Inherited choice dependencies retain their scope. [Integration](../../../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CONTEXTUAL-LOGIC-INTEGRATION.md) distinguishes merged-state budgets from frozen-frame execution and retains full-compatibility counterexamples.

**共享上下文续研 / Contextual logic continuation，2026-10-08。** F01成对接入[当前整合](CONTEXTUAL-LOGIC-INTEGRATION.md)，更新第一轮历史性待做状态：37项新定理／220项闭包审计、固定上下文的精确判据、指定工作负载摘要及完整相容性反例。/ Only the F01 continuation, its authored sources and canonical row are updated; other entries and pending concurrent reviews are preserved. [Edits](CONTEXTUAL-LOGIC-INDEX-EDITS.json); [checks](CONTEXTUAL-LOGIC-CHECKS.json). The first documentary receipt remains historical; this is no whole-table certification.

entry_before.title_zh: 过程核心、谓词与路径组合
entry_before.claim_zh: 给定变化关系后，有限历史通过实际共同中间配置组合；谓词可陈述保持性、可能性及全称终点性质，忠实抽象有明确局部条件。 生成逻辑首轮在左单位与原生上下文相容条件下，证明资源演算的收缩可容许当且仅当实际复制可达；有限供给有精确付费替代界限。 新的有限逐前缀继续谓词接入同一核心：每个请求步骤可继续，全部完成终点满足目标；有相反回应与成功后须调整的机制见证。
entry_before.claim_en: Given a transition relation, finite histories compose through a shared reached configuration; predicates express invariance, possibility and universal endpoint properties, with explicit local conditions for faithful abstraction. A logic pilot proves contraction admissible in a resource calculus exactly when duplication is reachable, under a left unit and primitive context compatibility; finite provision has a sharp paid-replacement bound. A finite prefix-sensitive obligation extends the same core: every requested step can continue and all completed endpoints meet the target, with mechanisms for opposite responses and adjustment after success.
entry_before.scope_zh: 逻辑、配置／事件域及变化关系明确给定，未由此导出全部规律或伦理方向。完整说明附六模块61项空依赖审计，其中核心18项、新教学定理12项；可能性、无执行时的空真与实际进展分别保留。旧回执仍可查。 新38项定理／65项总审计（51空），含顺序复用不保证重叠、上下文干扰与完整补给包不可复制的反例。形成的是即时就绪；任意有限准备已计入可达性。未导出元逻辑或确立前沿新颖性；共享上下文、及时性与忠实抽象待继续比较。 新11项定理继承39项审计；50项中44空、6仅标准依赖。终点正确可遗漏中断；实际调度、物理时间与目标伦理根据另列。
entry_before.scope_en: Logic, configuration/event domains and dynamics remain explicit inputs; this does not derive every law or ethical direction. The exposition checks six modules with 61 empty dependency audits, including 18 core audits and 12 new pedagogical theorems; possibility, vacuity and actual progress remain distinct. The earlier receipt is retained. New pilot: 38 theorems / 65 total audits (51 empty), retaining serial/overlap, contextual interference and funded-package duplication boundaries. Immediate readiness forms; unrestricted reachability already includes preparation. Metalogic and novelty are not established; shared contexts, timeliness and faithful abstraction remain for comparison. Eleven new theorems plus 39 inherited audits; 44 of 50 reports empty, six standard only. Correct endpoints can omit interruption; scheduling, physical time and ethical target warrant remain separate.

entry_after.title_zh: 过程核心、谓词与路径组合
entry_after.claim_zh: 给定变化关系后，有限历史通过实际共同中间配置组合；谓词可陈述保持性、可能性及全称终点性质，忠实抽象有明确局部条件。 生成逻辑首轮在左单位与原生上下文相容条件下，证明资源演算的收缩可容许当且仅当实际复制可达；有限供给有精确付费替代界限。 新的有限逐前缀继续谓词接入同一核心：每个请求步骤可继续，全部完成终点满足目标；有相反回应与成功后须调整的机制见证。 第二轮从原生占用规律推出局部历史允许的固定上下文精确判据；单相关支承位摘要保留所选工作负载的执行与整体事件步数预算。
entry_after.claim_en: Given a transition relation, finite histories compose through a shared reached configuration; predicates express invariance, possibility and universal endpoint properties, with explicit local conditions for faithful abstraction. A logic pilot proves contraction admissible in a resource calculus exactly when duplication is reachable, under a left unit and primitive context compatibility; finite provision has a sharp paid-replacement bound. A finite prefix-sensitive obligation extends the same core: every requested step can continue and all completed endpoints meet the target, with mechanisms for opposite responses and adjustment after success. A continuation derives the exact frozen-context criterion from native occupancy laws; a relevant-slot summary preserves selected execution and merged-state event-count budgets.
entry_after.scope_zh: 逻辑、配置／事件域及变化关系明确给定，未由此导出全部规律或伦理方向。完整说明附六模块61项空依赖审计，其中核心18项、新教学定理12项；可能性、无执行时的空真与实际进展分别保留。旧回执仍可查。 新38项定理／65项总审计（51空），含顺序复用不保证重叠、上下文干扰与完整补给包不可复制的反例。形成的是即时就绪；任意有限准备已计入可达性。未导出元逻辑或确立前沿新颖性；第一轮提出的上下文与摘要目标已由本次有范围结果接续。 新11项定理继承39项审计；50项中44空、6仅标准依赖。终点正确可遗漏中断；实际调度、物理时间与目标伦理根据另列。 新37项定理／220项闭包审计（124空）；新证明无经典选择。初始完整相容性、局部历史与固定占用条件明示；总量摘要失败，单支承摘要不能认证遗漏位置的相容性。整体预算不等于保持其他占用的准备，步数不等于真实时间。Iris/Leaf已有先例，仍属完成的整合而非新颖性证明。
entry_after.scope_en: Logic, configuration/event domains and dynamics remain explicit inputs; this does not derive every law or ethical direction. The exposition checks six modules with 61 empty dependency audits, including 18 core audits and 12 new pedagogical theorems; possibility, vacuity and actual progress remain distinct. The earlier receipt is retained. New pilot: 38 theorems / 65 total audits (51 empty), retaining serial/overlap, contextual interference and funded-package duplication boundaries. Immediate readiness forms; unrestricted reachability already includes preparation. Metalogic and novelty are not established; the first-round context/abstraction target is continued by the scoped results below. Eleven new theorems plus 39 inherited audits; 44 of 50 reports empty, six standard only. Correct endpoints can omit interruption; scheduling, physical time and ethical target warrant remain separate. Continuation: 37 new theorems / 220 closure audits (124 empty), no new choice dependency. Full initial compatibility, a valid local history and a frozen frame are explicit. Counts lose readiness; the selected summary loses hidden-slot compatibility. Merged-state budgets do not imply preparation preserving held occupancy, and steps are not physical time. Iris/Leaf precedents remain credited; the scoped integration is complete, without a novelty claim.
